canDoYue: 你識講發燒同咳嗽，仲識講之後會去藥房。
canDoEn: Describe a fever and a cough, then say you will go to the pharmacy.

dialogue.speaker: kai
dialogue.text: Good morning. You have an appointment, and I can help you at the clinic today.
dialogue.glossYue: 早晨。你今日有預約，我喺診所可以幫你。
dialogue.say: Good morning. You have an appointment, and I can help you at the clinic today.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I have had a fever and cough since Monday, and my sore throat feels worse.
dialogue.glossYue: 我由星期一起發燒同咳嗽，條喉嚨仲差咗。
dialogue.say: I have had a fever and cough since Monday, and my sore throat feels worse.

dialogue.speaker: kai
dialogue.text: Do you have a headache too, and do you have an allergy to this medicine?
dialogue.glossYue: 你有冇頭痛？你對呢隻藥有冇過敏？
dialogue.say: Do you have a headache too, and do you have an allergy to this medicine?

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I have had a headache since Monday, and I have a food allergy as well.
dialogue.glossYue: 我由星期一起頭痛，我亦都有食物過敏。
dialogue.say: I have had a headache since Monday, and I have a food allergy as well.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I have had a cough since Monday, and I can rest after the pharmacy visit.
dialogue.glossYue: 我由星期一起咳，去完藥房我可以休息。
dialogue.say: I have had a cough since Monday, and I can rest after the pharmacy visit.

dialogue.speaker: kai
dialogue.text: You can rest at home, and the pharmacy can prepare this prescription for you today.
dialogue.glossYue: 你可以喺屋企休息，藥房今日可以幫你配呢張藥單。
dialogue.say: You can rest at home, and the pharmacy can prepare this prescription for you today.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I will take the prescription to the pharmacy, and I need a follow-up after rest.
dialogue.glossYue: 我會帶藥單去藥房，休息之後要覆診。
dialogue.say: I will take the prescription to the pharmacy, and I need a follow-up after rest.

dialogue.speaker: kai
dialogue.text: Please rest today, and the clinic can see you for a follow-up after the pharmacy.
dialogue.glossYue: 請你今日休息，去完藥房診所可以同你覆診。
dialogue.say: Please rest today, and the clinic can see you for a follow-up after the pharmacy.
